After being freed from [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]], [[Stevan Makintay]] returned to [[Hargeeva]] and established a '''rebel cell'''. Unfortunately, the movement grew too quickly and erupted into a full scale [[Hargeeva uprising|uprising]] which was brutally put down. Makintay and a few others escaped off-world in the aftermath.
